semantics.timing: No clock or latency; original rows occur at 0 through 90 ns in 5 ns increments.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset or stored state specified; row at 0 ns specifies all inputs and q as 0.

numeric.operations: Boolean bitwise OR and AND; no arithmetic or signedness

verification.oracle: Literal expected q from original waveform, independent of RTL expression
verification.stimulus: Replay all 19 original rows at exact 5 ns intervals starting at 0 ns; sample after delta-cycle settling at each row. Then exhaust all 16 binary combinations in reverse order using literal truth-table lookup.
verification.failure: Case-inequality mismatches cause $fatal; timeout is bounded; PASS emitted only after every check.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z inputs is not specified; verification covers the binary waveform domain. Zero-delay combinational settling is sampled after a delta-cycle without shifting original stimulus timestamps.
